provenance.source: Structural-trajectory region concordance v2: country-level development archetypes (World Bank income classification, FY2025 release) aggregated to EXIOBASE coarse-v3 blocks with documented GDP weights (IMF WEO Oct-2024 nominal GDP, current USD)
provenance.licence: derived mapping (CC BY 4.0); World Bank income classification (CC BY 4.0), IMF WEO (public, cited not redistributed)
provenance.world_bank_vintage: FY2025 (July 2024 release; Russia = high-income in this vintage)
provenance.notes: Fixes review P1 (2026-08-29): the coarse-v3 blocks RoW_Asia / RoW_America / RoW_Europe mix income levels, so a SINGLE archetype cannot be derived from an income rule. This artifact instead assigns each MEMBER COUNTRY an archetype (N=high-income proxy, S=low/middle-income proxy) by the World Bank FY2025 income classification, and aggregates each block's trajectory as the GDP-WEIGHTED blend of its members' archetype paths — so a mixed block (e.g. RoW_Asia, which contains high-income AU/KR/TW and emerging ID plus the WA rest-of-Asia aggregate) gets a blended, not a wholly-emerging, path. The World Bank vintage is pinned explicitly (FY2025), which places Russia in the HIGH-income group — resolving the earlier RU ambiguity. GDP weights are IMF WEO Oct-2024 nominal GDP shares (current USD), documented and reviewable; the W* rest-of-region aggregates carry the block's residual weight tagged as an emerging-economy proxy. The archetype rate paths themselves live in trajectories_v1.json (N/S). This file is the reviewable bridge; the loader aggregates with these weights.
provenance.gdp_weight_note: Weights are approximate 2024 nominal-GDP shares within each block (IMF WEO Oct-2024), rounded to 3 dp and renormalised to sum to 1 per block. They are documented illustrative weights, not a committed extraction pipeline (a reproducible IMF/WB extraction is a follow-up, consistent with the trajectories_v1 reproducibility caveat).

sources.country_archetype: World Bank country and lending groups, FY2025 income classification (July 2024 release). High-income → N; low/lower-middle/upper-middle → S. https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/906519
sources.block_membership: EXIOBASE coarse-v3 region folding (cge.data.build._coarse_region), with GDP weights from IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2024 (nominal GDP, current USD). https://www.imf.org/en/Publications/WEO
sources.sector_archetype: ISIC Rev.4 / EU KLEMS goods-vs-services split. https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/isic
